name: ostrovok2026
description: AI-агент для умного поиска и бронирования отелей (О!Хакатон 2026 — Трек №2)

scripts.dev: node scripts/guard-dev-environment.mjs && concurrently -n "front,back" -c "cyan,magenta" "bun run dev:front" "bun run dev:back"
scripts.dev:static-back: node scripts/guard-dev-environment.mjs && concurrently -n "front,back" -c "cyan,magenta" "bun run dev:front" "bun run --cwd backend start"
scripts.lint: bun run --cwd frontend lint && bun run --cwd backend lint
scripts.lint:fix: bun run --cwd frontend lint:fix && bun run --cwd backend lint:fix
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd frontend typecheck && bun run --cwd backend typecheck
scripts.test: bun run test:front && bun run test:back
scripts.setup: bun run setup:front && bun run setup:back
